subject.size_in_frame: her face high in frame and only half in it — the top of her head and one cheek are cropped by the top edge; her knee and a wall of blue cotton take the rest of the picture

headroom: none, and deliberately negative: she is too tall for her own close-up. The frame's top edge cuts her, which is the shot's first statement.
horizon_eyeline: Lens on the flagstones at 0.35 m straight across the hall. The dry flagstone line runs across at 0.88 of frame height. Her eyeline is at 0.28 and drops through the shot as she hunches — the highest eyeline in the second half of the episode and the last time it is up there.

layers.fg: her knee and shin coming up from the bottom of frame, a mass of blue cotton
layers.mg: her face, high and half-cropped, hunched under the vault
layers.bg: the dark hall, dry stone still, and the vault pressing down behind her — and from this frame to the end of the episode, no lamp fitting anywhere

gaze.note: she sits up, sees the door is still impossible, and her look drops. No lead room; every direction in this frame is blocked by her own body or by stone.

balance: Crowded to the upper right and lower left by the same person, with no empty quadrant anywhere. The frame has run out of room, which is the subject.
leading_lines: The line of her shin and the line of her forearm make a closed acute angle across the frame; the vault curve closes the top. Everything is a wedge, and she is inside it.
eye_first: Her face at the top of frame, half out of it, then her knee — the two things that prove she does not fit.
constraint_binding: From this frame to the end of the episode the camera stays below 1.0 m and NO lamp fixture appears in frame. The composition observes both: the lens is on the flagstones, the top edge is set below the 2.30 m lamp line, and no fitting, halo, shade or chain enters the picture. Dry stone still — no water anywhere in frame yet.
